name: OpenVibe.Host
notes: Stage A: the ovhost operator CLI (no server). Stage B: the Host API service on port 4910 (unit openvibe-host.service, state /var/lib/openvibe-host-api): tenant projects keyed by project id (prj_, network_project_id once Network has projects, ADR-014), static sites served by Host header at <site>.openvibe.host (a registrable domain separate from every other OpenVibe domain) and on TXT-verified custom domains, immutable content-addressed deploys with rollback, quotas enforced here, upload logs. Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO, JWKS, client-credentials) and publishes through OpenVibe.Events (events.event.publish). Stage C (sandboxed user code) is not started.
